column1: # Weapons. Units reference these ids in units.csv (weapon1 ... weapon5).
# range       : attack range in tiles (Manhattan distance)
# ap          : armour piercing (only matters against armour > 0)
# will_damage : willpower removed from the target per hit
# cooldown    : turns the weapon cannot be used after firing (0 = none)
# needs_radio : 1 = can only be used while a friendly unit with the attribute "radio" is alive
# ammo        : shots (uses) per unit before it must be resupplied by a Supply. 0 / empty / inf = unlimited.
#               units.csv can override it per unit with ammo1..ammo5 (e.g. Rifleman 3 shots
# type        : damage (default) | heal | repair | refuel | supply
#               heal   = restores `damage` HP of friendly INFANTRY (shown green)
#               repair = restores `damage` HP of friendly VEHICLES
#               refuel = refills a friendly vehicle's fuel to its default
#               supply = refills ALL ammo + fuel of the target. `damage` = how many supplies it hands over when the
#                        target is another supply truck (add to the target
#               (support weapons only work on friendly units that need them; ap / will_damage are ignored)
